summary: Outside the Heart O' The City Hotel in daylight, Agent Smith is moving when he suddenly halts. He pauses as though something registers as familiar to him, and the faded NEON BUZZES, spelling out Heart O' The City Hotel.

what_changes.after: pausing as if recognizing something about the hotel
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith suddenly pauses as if recognizing something; the faded NEON BUZZES:  Heart O' The City Hotel.

event_hint.one_line: During the pursuit of Neo, Agent Smith abruptly stops, arrested by the Heart O' The City Hotel.

objects_that_matter: the faded NEON reading Heart O' The City Hotel
uncertain: What exactly Agent Smith recognizes or why it registers
Whether Neo or anyone else is present in this scene
